seo_description: Explore USA scholarships up to $5,000 for 2026 in our filtered list. Compare deadlines, search keywords, and open official program pages to apply.
intro: Smaller awards still help cover books, fees, and living costs across the school year. This USA scholarships view for 2026 focuses on parsed amounts up to five thousand dollars so you can explore many paths without assuming one giant prize. Browse the list, compare deadlines, and use search when you already know a keyword or organization you want to target before you apply through each sponsor’s official instructions.
